; RSA/SHA-256 with a 2048-bit key generated with openssl, signed over the RFC 5702 6.1 RRset (inception 2000-01-01, expiration 2030-01-01).
; ring cannot verify the RFC's 512-bit key, so this covers the algorithm 8 path with a supported key size.
example.net. 3600 IN DNSKEY 256 3 8 
www.example.net. 3600 IN A 192.0.2.91
www.example.net. 3600 IN RRSIG A 8 3 3600 20300101000000 20000101000000 47184 example.net.
